label: Switch on-resistance and IR drop
subgoals: Treat N parallel switches as one resistance of R over N
Multiply the block current by that resistance for the drop
Include the virtual-rail drop in the block's timing

label: Sizing the switch network
subgoals: Divide the current times on-resistance by the drop budget
Round up to a whole number of switches
Trade switch count against area and off-state switch leakage

label: Rush current and wake-up time
subgoals: Limit rush current by enabling switches in a daisy chain
Divide the stored charge by the current limit for wake-up time
Compare leakage saved while off with the energy of waking up
